doing.why: Movement brief, pixel effects and the Seeker characters are in. Next is the owner's call: keep the Seeker or go back to stick figures, the run button, and which reviewer defects to take on.

Owner: name the game to rate against (the first rating used Stick Fight: The Game)
Owner: read the spec diff and run `pnpm accept` to sign off the 40 rules
Owner: decide whether to commit; the repo is still a clone of the vibestack template with its history
Run the browser journey test (`pnpm --filter @repo/app test:browser`)
Host the workbench behind a password so it opens on a phone

Unused pack animations: crouch, enter door, grapple

pixelfx effects run live in the game, in each fighter's colours: plasma explosions, mana bursts, an implosion on Overdrive, poofs on teleports and knockouts, ground slams, flame pillars, zaps, crit and hit sparks, thorns and a quake on Eruption, a whirlpool
